title: Argo Events / Operations
description: Curated health view of Argo Events in the homelab: controller, EventSources, Sensors and the NATS JetStream EventBus. Built from the Argo Events v1.9.11 metrics docs (https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md, golden signals), the prometheus-nats-exporter / NATS monitoring docs and controller-runtime metrics. No upstream Argo Events dashboard exists.

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What Argo Events does here.** Argo Events v1.9.11 (chart 2.4.28, namespace `argo-events`): the
**controller-manager** reconciles EventBus/EventSource/Sensor objects into pods. **EventSource `argocd`** receives the
Argo CD notifications webhook (sync succeeded/failed, health degraded), publishes each event to the **EventBus `default`**
(NATS JetStream 2.10.29, one server, stream `default` on a local-path volume), and **Sensor `argocd`** consumes it and
runs its trigger (today: `log`). An event that is not on the bus or a trigger that fails is lost work.

**Scrape:** controller :7777 (ServiceMonitor of the chart). The EventSource/Sensor pods (:7777, `argo_events_*` user
metrics) and the NATS exporter sidecar of the EventBus (:7777, `nats_*`) are scraped by PodMonitors added with this
dashboard — **those rows are "pending scrape" until argo-events-raw is synced.** The EventSource/Sensor duration metrics
are summaries without quantiles: panels show the average.

**Healthy looks like:** every component UP, events sent = actions triggered, 0 failed events / failed actions, consumer
pending near 0, no slow consumers. **When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 -n argo-events logs -l eventsource-name=argocd`,
`… logs -l sensor-name=argocd`, `… logs eventbus-default-js-0 -c main`, `kubectl --context k8s01 -n argo-events get eventbus,eventsources,sensors`.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Controller
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the controller-manager (:7777). Down = EventBus/EventSource/Sensor changes are not applied (running pods keep working). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md. Derived query: Prometheus `up`.

panels.title: EventSource pods
panels.description: Available replicas of the EventSource Deployments (`<name>-eventsource-*`). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/blob/main/docs/metrics/workload/deployment-metrics.md.

panels.title: Sensor pods
panels.description: Available replicas of the Sensor Deployments (`<name>-sensor-*`). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/blob/main/docs/metrics/workload/deployment-metrics.md.

panels.title: EventBus ready
panels.description: Ready replicas of StatefulSet eventbus-default-js (NATS JetStream, 1 expected). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/blob/main/docs/metrics/workload/statefulset-metrics.md.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Argo Events image of the controller-manager (must match v1.9.11). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/blob/main/docs/metrics/workload/pod-metrics.md.

panels.title: Event services running
panels.description: Event services configured in EventSources that are actively running (`argo_events_event_service_running_total`, saturation signal). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Failed events (24h)
panels.description: Events that failed to process or reach the EventBus (`events_processing_failed_total`, which includes `events_sent_failed_total`). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Events sent to the EventBus
panels.description: Events published per second by EventSource/event (`argo_events_events_sent_total`, traffic golden signal). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Failed events
panels.description: Events that failed to process (`events_processing_failed_total`) and the subset that failed to reach the EventBus (`events_sent_failed_total`). Alert `ArgoEventsEventProcessingFailed`. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Event processing time (avg)
panels.description: Receive → published on the EventBus, average (`argo_events_event_processing_duration_milliseconds` _sum/_count; latency golden signal). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md. Derived query: average from _sum/_count.

panels.title: Actions triggered
panels.description: Triggers executed successfully per Sensor/trigger (`argo_events_action_triggered_total`). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Failed actions
panels.description: Trigger attempts that failed (`action_failed_total`) and actions given up after the retries (`action_retries_failed_total`, also counted when no retryStrategy is set) — the latter is lost work, alert `ArgoEventsSensorActionFailed`. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Action duration (avg)
panels.description: Trigger execution time, average (`argo_events_action_duration_milliseconds` _sum/_count). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-events/blob/v1.9.11/docs/metrics.md. Derived query: average from _sum/_count.

targets.expr: sum by (sensor_name, trigger_name) (rate(argo_events_action_duration_milliseconds_sum{job="argo-events/sensors"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (sensor_name, trigger_name) (rate(argo_events_action_duration_milliseconds_count{job="argo-events/sensors"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: NATS exporter
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the prometheus-nats-exporter sidecar of eventbus-default-js-0 (alert `NatsServerDown` when it disappears). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/nats-io/prometheus-nats-exporter/tree/v0.14.0.

panels.title: NATS version
panels.description: `nats_varz_version` (must match the EventBus pin 2.10.29). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring (/varz).

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Client connections (EventSources + Sensors + controller; `nats_varz_connections`). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: Slow consumers
panels.description: Clients the server had to drop because they could not keep up (`nats_varz_slow_consumers`, cumulative since the server started; alert `NatsSlowConsumers`). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: JetStream storage
panels.description: Bytes stored by JetStream on the 5 Gi volume (`nats_varz_jetstream_stats_storage`). The configured max (`jetstream_config_max_storage`) is derived from the node disk, not the PVC: compare with 5 GiB and with the stream limit maxBytes 1 GB. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring (/jsz).

panels.title: NATS memory
panels.description: Resident memory of nats-server (`nats_varz_mem`; container limit 512 Mi; alert `NatsHighMemoryUsage` above 200 MB). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: JetStream API errors (24h)
panels.description: Errors returned by the JetStream API (`nats_varz_jetstream_stats_api_errors`, cumulative; alert `NatsTooManyErrors` above 5 in 5 min). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: NATS CPU
panels.description: CPU of nats-server in percent (`nats_varz_cpu`, 0-100 scale; alert `NatsHighCpuUsage` above 80). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: Messages in / out
panels.description: Messages received and delivered by the server per second (`nats_varz_in_msgs` / `nats_varz_out_msgs`). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://docs.nats.io/running-a-nats-service/nats_admin/monitoring.

panels.title: Stream size
panels.description: Messages stored per JetStream stream (`nats_stream_total_messages`; stream `default` = events, `KV_*` = Sensor state). Limits: maxMsgs 100000, maxAge 72h, maxBytes 1 GB (chart values). **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/nats-io/prometheus-nats-exporter/tree/v0.14.0.

panels.title: Consumer backlog
panels.description: Per consumer (one per Sensor dependency group): messages not yet delivered (`nats_consumer_num_pending`), delivered but not acknowledged (`num_ack_pending`) and redelivered. A growing pending = a Sensor is not keeping up or is down. **Pending scrape**: PodMonitor added in argo-events-raw (resources/monitoring.yaml); empty until it is synced. Source: https://github.com/nats-io/prometheus-nats-exporter/tree/v0.14.0.

panels.title: Reconciliations by controller and result
panels.description: controller-runtime reconciles of eventbus/eventsource/sensor controllers by result (success, error, requeue). Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Reconcile errors by controller
panels.description: Reconcile errors (e.g. invalid spec, EventBus not ready). Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Workqueue depth
panels.description: Items waiting per controller queue. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Reconcile duration (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile reconcile time per controller. Source: https://book.kubebuilder.io/reference/metrics-reference.

panels.title: Kubernetes API responses
panels.description: Requests from the controller to the API server by method and code (`rest_client_requests_total`; 409 Conflict on PUT is an optimistic-lock retry, normal). Source: https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/instrumentation/metrics/.

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory per Argo Events (controller, EventSource, Sensor, EventBus) container (solid) and its limit (dashed). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used per Argo Events (controller, EventSource, Sensor, EventBus) container. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.
